objectives.name: Demographic parity
objectives.description: Positive prediction rates must not differ materially across protected groups.
objectives.rationale: The model makes decisions about individuals and must not discriminate.

objectives.name: Ranking quality
objectives.description: The model must keep acceptable discrimination performance.
objectives.rationale: Art. 15 requires an appropriate level of accuracy.

assumptions: Thresholds are initial proposals and must be validated against the intended use.
